query: I fetched my lending positions from the XOXNO API. How much USDC do I actually have supplied? The response has supplyAmount and supplyScaledRay.
expected_behavior: Treats AccountPositionDto.supplyAmount / borrowAmount as RAY (1e27) token quantities, never as base units, and rescales 27 -> asset decimals (divide by 10^(27-decimals)) before display

Derives the balance as round(supplyScaledRay * liveSupplyIndexRay / 1e27) then round(value_ray / 10^(27-decimals)), naming the rounding per boundary: floor for a supply claim paid in tokens, ceil for the debt full-close amount, half-up for the displayed balance
Performs the arithmetic in BigInt or BigNumber on the raw string fields, not in float Number
Uses liveSupplyIndexRay (falling back to supplyIndexRay) rather than assuming the index is 1e27
Does not divide a RAY quantity by 1e18 (WAD) or by 10^decimals directly
